Measures how well a metric model finds rows of the same class among their nearest neighbours.

Side node on the encoder output of a Pair / Triplet Dataset Builder graph. At every validated epoch (validation rows), at the end of training (held-out test rows) and in the Test step, every row is a query against all the other rows (leave-one-out, Euclidean distance; up to 4096 rows): Recall@k is the share of queries with a same-class row among their k nearest, MRR the mean of 1 / rank of the first same-class row, 1-NN agreement the share whose nearest row is of their class. Cosine Embedding models are measured on L2-normalised embeddings.

None: the node ends a branch of the graph.
